svg.text: Separated helmet, shoulders and boots. Identity is color + callsign; appearance never encodes alignment.

Authoritative life changes at the confirmed event. Only the visual child eases; the motor and server clock do not wait.
0–90 ms anticipation · 90–160 ms impulse · 160–360 ms fall · 360–640 ms settle. No camera takeover; reduced motion = impact + body.
Witness-scoped sound and VFX only. Event identity deduplicates playback. Death never reveals foreign Alignment.
